import numpy as np

# Individual income tax receipts (net of refunds) for fiscal years 1929-1942
# From the table, these are in thousands of dollars
years = [1929, 1930, 1931, 1932, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942]
receipts_thousands = [1095541, 1146845, 833648, 427191, 352573, 419509, 527113, 674416, 1091741, 1286312, 1028834, 982017, 1417655, 3262800]

# Convert to billions (divide by 1,000,000)
receipts = np.array(receipts_thousands) / 1_000_000

# Perform OLS regression
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(years)), years])
y = receipts

# Calculate beta using least squares: beta = (X'X)^-1 X'y
beta = np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X) @ X.T @ y

intercept, slope = beta
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")

# Project to year 2000
year_2000 = 2000
projected = intercept + slope * year_2000
print(f"\nProjected for year 2000: {projected:.4f} billions")

# Actual for FY 2000 (from the 2001 bulletin): net individual income tax
# In the table: column "Net" under "Income taxes" = 1,004,461 million = 1,004.461 billion
actual_2000 = 1004461 / 1000  # Convert million to billion
print(f"Actual for year 2000: {actual_2000:.4f} billions")

# Difference: actual - projected
diff = actual_2000 - projected
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {diff:.4f} billions")
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(diff, 1)}")
EOF
